_comment: Client-side feature flags. Each flag is { enabled: bool, launchAt: ISO-8601-UTC string or null }. A flag is ON if enabled===true, OR if launchAt is set and that UTC time is now in the past. This file IS deployed (it lives in src/), so treat it as PUBLIC — never gate anything secret on a client flag; use it for soft reveals only. See src/flags.js for the helper and SCHEDULED-RELEASES.md for usage.
_lifecycle: The site moves through three states, each a superset of the last. prelaunchOpen is on now; fullLaunch flips itself on automatically at the launchAt below — nothing needs deploying that morning. Both flags stay in the file afterwards so the transition is auditable and reversible: set fullLaunch.launchAt to null to roll back to prelaunch without a code change.

prelaunchOpen._note: Prelaunch. Home page captures an email and sends an immediate invite to create an account. Replaced waitlistOpen on 2026-08-06 — the flow no longer holds people on a list, it invites them straight in.

fullLaunch._note: Full launch. Nav CTA becomes 'Sign up' with 'Sign in' beside it, and the home hero switches from email capture to direct account creation. 2026-08-24T07:00:00Z = 08:00 BST, Monday morning — deliberately a Monday so a full working week follows any problem.

waitlistOpen._note: DEPRECATED 2026-08-06, superseded by prelaunchOpen. Left in place because older cached pages may still reference it; remove once fullLaunch has been live for a while.
